info.title: Freshsales Classic Universal API
info.description: Freshsales Classic is a Freshworks CRM integration for managing contacts, accounts, deals, tasks, search, and related sales data through the legacy Freshsales API.

get.description: Retrieves sales activities from Freshsales Classic.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return.

schema.description: Page number to return.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

additionalUserCount.description: Count of additional associated users when present.

checkedinAt.description: Timestamp of the check-in when present.

checkedinDuration.description: Duration spent checked in, in seconds, when present.

checkedoutLatitude.description: Latitude captured at checkout when present.

checkedoutLocation.description: Location captured at checkout when present.

checkedoutLongitude.description: Longitude captured at checkout when present.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID linked to the sales activity when present.

conversationTime.description: Conversation timestamp associated with the activity when present.

createrId.description: ID of the user who created the sales activity.

customField.description: Custom field payload for the sales activity when present.

endDate.description: End timestamp of the sales activity.

hasMultipleEmails.description: Whether multiple target emails are associated.

id.description: Unique ID of the sales activity.

latitude.description: Latitude captured for the activity location when present.

location.description: Location associated with the sales activity when present.

longitude.description: Longitude captured for the activity location when present.

noteId.description: Note ID associated with the sales activity when present.

notes.description: Description or notes for the sales activity.

ownerId.description: ID of the user who owns the sales activity.

salesActivityOutcomeId.description: ID of the selected sales activity outcome when present.

salesActivityTypeId.description: ID of the sales activity type.

startDate.description: Start timestamp of the sales activity.

status.description: Whether the sales activity is marked completed.

targetableId.description: ID of the related contact, account, or deal.

targetables.description: Related target entities for the sales activity.

targetablesWithEmail.description: Related target entities with display names.

targetableType.description: Entity type related to the sales activity.

updaterId.description: ID of the user who last updated the sales activity when present.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
